<h4>Service Sale</h4>

+ To Create Service sale(sale that contains only service products) set parameter ServiceOnly = true, when creating new Sale. you can't change it later.
+ For Service Sale `Sale Order` and `Sale Fulfilment` endpoints are unavailable.
+ For Service Sale Credit Note Restock Property is readonly.
+ For Service Sale `TaskID` Always  = `SaleID`
+ Even if service products added to Service sale as `Additional Charge`, it will be processed as usual product line.

### Sale Types
+ Simple Sale: Sale that contains single invoice/fulfilment/credit note per sale order.
+ Advanced sale: Sale that contains multiple invoices/fulfilments/credit notes per sale order.
+ Service-Only sale: Same as simple sale, but contains only service products instead of stock products and has no additional charges.

<a id="SaleStatesList"></a>

### Available Sale Statuses
|Status|Description|
|:-----|-----------|
|`DRAFT`|No data is added to sale details. Quote and order are empty and not authorised. This status is not used for sales created via the POST API.|
|`VOIDED`|Task has been voided|
|`ESTIMATING`|QuoteStatus = DRAFT, OrderStatus = NOT AVAILABLE|
|`ESTIMATED`|QuoteStatus = AUTHORISED or Skip Quote=true, OrderStatus = NOT AVAILABLE|
|`ORDERING`|OrderStatus = DRAFT|
|`ORDERED`|OrderStatus = AUTHORISED, all products in sale order are in stock, no backordering. PickStatus = NOT AVAILABLE|
|`BACKORDERED`|OrderStatus = AUTHORISED, at least one product in sale order has been backordered. PickStatus = NOT AVAILABLE|
|`PICKING`|PickStatus = DRAFT, only applicable to simple sale|
|`PICKED`|PickStatus = AUTHORISED, PackStatus = NOT AVAILABLE, only applicable to simple sale|
|`PACKING`|PackStatus = DRAFT, only applicable to simple sale|
|`PACKED`|PackStatus = AUTHORISED, ShipStatus = NOT AVAILABLE, only applicable to simple sale|
|`SHIPPING`|ShipStatus = DRAFT, only applicable to simple sale|
|`INVOICING`|OrderStatus=AUTHORISED, InvoiceStatus=DRAFT, only applicable to simple sale|
|`INVOICED`|InvoiceStatus = AUTHORISED or InvoiceStatus = PAID, CreditNoteStatus <> AUTHORISED, TotalInvoice – TotalPaid <> 0, only applicable to simple sale|
|`CREDITED`|CreditNoteStatus = AUTHORISED, TotalInvoice – TotalPaid <> 0, only applicable to simple sale|
|`COMPLETED`|InvoiceStatus = PAID, ShipStatus=AUTHORISED, TotalInvoice – TotalPaid = 0|

<a id="QuoteStatuses"></a>

### Available Quote Statuses
|Status|Description|
|:-----|-----------|
|`NOT AVAILABLE`|Not ready for processing.|
|`DRAFT`|Contains some lines, ready for processing|
|`AUTHORISED`|AUTHORISED|
|`VOIDED`|VOIDED|

<a id="OrderStatuses"></a>

### Available Order Statuses
|Status|Description|
|:-----|-----------|
|`NOT AVAILABLE`|Not ready for processing.|
|`DRAFT`|Contains some lines, ready for processing|
|`AUTHORISED`|AUTHORISED|
|`VOIDED`|VOIDED|
|`AUTH_NO_ALLOC`|AUTORISED, without stock allocation|
|`FULFILLED`|The order is FULFILLED, and no further fulfillments are required|
|`CLOSED`|The Invoice and Shipment stages are completed|

<a id="InvoiceStatuses"></a>

### Available Invoice Statuses
|Status|Description|
|:-----|-----------|
|`NOT AVAILABLE`|Not ready for processing.|
|`DRAFT`|Contains some lines, ready for processing|
|`AUTHORISED`|AUTHORISED|
|`VOIDED`|VOIDED|
|`PAID`|Fully Paid|

<a id="get-salelist"></a>
### GET /saleList?Page={Page}&Limit={Limit}&Search={Search}&CreatedSince={CreatedSince}&UpdatedSince={UpdatedSince}&ShipBy={ShipBy}&QuoteStatus={QuoteStatus}&OrderStatus={OrderStatus}&CombinedPickStatus={CombinedPickStatus}&CombinedPackStatus={CombinedPackStatus}&CombinedShippingStatus={CombinedShippingStatus}&CombinedInvoiceStatus={CombinedInvoiceStatus}&CreditNoteStatus={CreditNoteStatus}&ExternalID={ExternalID}&Status={Status}&ReadyForShipping={ReadyForShipping}&OrderLocationID={OrderLocationID}

Parameters:
- `Page` (optional, number): Page
  - default: 1
- `Limit` (optional, number): Specifies the page size for pagination. Default page size is 100.
  - default: 100
- `Search` (optional, string): Only return sales with search value contained in one of these fields: OrderNumber, Status, Customer, invoiceNumber, CustomerReference, CreditNoteNumber
- `CreatedSince` (optional, DateTime): Only return sales created after specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `UpdatedSince` (optional, DateTime): Only return sales changed after specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `UpdatedUntil` (optional, DateTime): Only return sales changed before specified date. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `ShipBy` (optional, DateTime): Only return sales with Ship By date on or before specified date, with not authorised Shipment. Date must follow  ISO 8601 format.
- `QuoteStatus` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified quote status
- `OrderStatus` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified order status
- `CombinedPickStatus` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified CombinedPickingStatus
- `CombinedPackStatus` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified CombinedPackingStatus
- `CombinedShippingStatus` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified CombinedShippingStatus
- `CombinedInvoiceStatus` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified CombinedInvoiceStatus
- `CreditNoteStatus` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified credit note status
- `ExternalID` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified External ID
- `Status` (optional, string): Only return sales with specified sale status
- `ReadyForShipping` (optional, boolean): Only return sales with 'Authorised' pack and not 'Authorised' shipping
- `OrderLocationID` (optional, Guid): Only return sales with specified Order Location ID

|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid|||Unique Cin7 Core Sale ID. Required for PUT|
|`Customer`|String|256||Customer name|
|`CustomerID`|Guid|||Customer identifier|
|`Contact`|String|256||Customer Contact name|
|`Phone`|String|50||Customer Contact phone|
|`Email`|String|256||Customer Contact email|
|`DefaultAccount`|String|50||Account code used by default for invoice lines when no revenue account is defined on Product. By default it is equal to Customer Sale account|
|`SkipQuote`|Boolean|||`True` if there is no quote in the sale|
|`BillingAddress`|<a href="#AddressModel"><b>Address Model</b></a>|||Sale Billing address|
|`ShippingAddress`|<a href="#SaleShippingAddressModel"><b>Shipping Address Model</b></a>|||Sale Shipping address|
|`ShippingNotes`|String|1024||Shipping Notes|
|`BaseCurrency`|String|3||3 character currency code of Base Currency defined in General Settings on the moment when Sale was created.|
|`CustomerCurrency`|String|3||3 character currency code of customer Currency defined in Customer card at the moment when customer is selected for the Sale.|
|`TaxRule`|String|50||Default Tax Rule name selected for Sale|
|`TaxCalculation`|String|||`Inclusive` or `Exclusive`|
|`Terms`|String|256||Payment terms name|
|`PriceTier`|String|50||Price Tier name selected for Sale|
|`ShipBy`|Date|||Date when shipment is due|
|`Location`|String|256||Default location to pick stock from|
|`SaleOrderDate`|Date|||Date when task was created|
|`LastModifiedOn`|DateTime|||UTC Time|
|`Note`|String|1024||Custom Sale note|
|`CustomerReference`|String|256||Reference number used by customer to identify this sale. Could be a purchase order number generated by customer.|
|`COGSAmount`|Money|||COGS amount in base currency|
|`Status`|String|25||Sale Status, see possible <a href="#SaleStatesList"><b>values</b></a>|
| `CombinedPickingStatus`  | String | 20        | Yes         | Pick status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `PICKED`, `PICKING` , `NOT PICKED` , `PARTIALLY PICKED`        |
| `CombinedPackingStatus`  | String | 20        | Yes         | Pack status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `PACKED`, `PACKING`, `NOT PACKED`, `PARTIALLY PACKED`       |
| `CombinedShippingStatus`  | String | 20        | Yes         | Ship status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `SHIPPED`, `SHIPPING` , `NOT SHIPPED`   , `PARTIALLY SHIPPED`         |
| `FulFilmentStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Fulfilment status. Possible Values are `FULFILLED`, `PARTIALLY FULFILLED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `NOT FULFILLED`, `VOIDED`         |
| `CombinedInvoiceStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Invoice status. Possible Values are `VOIDED`, `DRAFT`, `AUTHORISED`, `NOT AVAILABLE`, `PAID`        |
| `CombinedPaymentStatus`  | String | 20        |          | Payment status. Possible Values are `NOT REFUNDED`, `PREPAID`, `PARTIALLY PAID`, `UNPAID`, `PAID`, `VOIDED`       |
| `CombinedTrackingNumbers`  | String | 256        |          | Tracking Numbers        |
| `Carrier`  | String | 256        |  Name of Carrier/shipping method        |       |
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal|Up to 5 decimal places||Conversion Rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Customer currency unit|
|`SalesRepresentative`|String|256||Sales representative name |
|`Type`|String|50||Type of sale: `Simple Sale` or `Advanced Sale`, `Service Sale`|
| `SourceChannel`  | String | 32        |          | Source of the sale. read-only field       |
| `ExternalID`  | String | 256        |          | Custom field that is only available in API and allows to set arbitrary value for the sale for later search and any custom logic        |
|`ServiceOnly`|Boolean|||`true` when it is service-only sale|
|`Quote`|<a href="#SaleQuoteModel"><b>Sale Quote Model</b></a>|||Sale Quote|
|`Order`|<a href="#SaleOrderModel"><b>Sale Order Model</b></a>|||Sale Order|
|`Fulfilments`|<a href="#SaleFulfilmentModel"><b>[] Sale Fulfilment Model</b></a>|||Sale Fulfilments|
|`Invoices`|<a href="#SaleInvoiceModel"><b>[] Sale Invoice Model</b></a>|||Sale Invoices|
|`CreditNotes`|<a href="#SaleCreditNoteModel"><b>[] Sale Credit Note Model</b></a>|||Sale Credit Notes|
|`ManualJournals`|<a href="#SaleManualJournalModel"><b>Sale Manual Journal Model</b></a>|||Sale Manual Journals|
|`AdditionalAttributes`|<a href="#AdditionalAttributeModel"><b>Additional Attribute Model</b></a>|||Sale Additional Attributes|
|`Attachments`|<a href="#AttachmentLineModel"><b>[] Attachment Line Model</b></a>|||Sale Attachments|
|`InventoryMovements`|<a href="#InventoryMovementLineModel"><b>[] Inventory Movement Line Model</b></a>|||Sale Inventory Movements|
|`Transactions`|<a href="#SaleTransactionLineModel"><b>[] Sale Transaction Line Model</b></a>|||Sale Transactions|

+ All Objects that contain field 'ProductID', also contain additional fields.

### Additional fields
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ProductLength`|Decimal|||Length of product|
|`ProductWidth`|Decimal|||Width of product|
|`ProductHeight`|Decimal|||Height of product|
|`ProductWeight`|Decimal|||Weight of product|
| `WeightUnits`  | String             | 10        |          |Unit of measure for unit weight. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
| `DimensionsUnits`  | String             | 10        |      |Unit of measure for unit length/width/height. Available Values are <a href="#DimensionUnitAvailableValues"><b>values</b></a>|
|`ProductCustomField1`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 1 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|

|`ProductCustomField7`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 7 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField8`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 8 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|
|`ProductCustomField9`|String|||Value of Product's additional attribute 9 <br> Date format: Use `yyyy-mm-dd` <br> Numeric format: Enter a number with max 4 decimal palces|

### Sale POST/PUT Attributes

|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`ID`|Guid||Yes*|Unique Cin7 Core Sale ID. Required for PUT|
|`Customer`|String|256|Yes*|Customer name. Required if CustomerID not provided|
|`CustomerID`|Guid||Yes*|Customer identifier|
|`Contact`|String|256||Customer Contact name|
|`Phone`|String|50||Customer Contact phone|
|`Email`|String|256||Customer Contact email|
|`DefaultAccount`|String|50||Account code used by default for invoice lines when no revenue account is defined on Product. By default it is equal to Customer Sale account|
|`SkipQuote`|Boolean|||`True` if there is no quote in the sale|
|`BillingAddress`|<a href="#AddressModel"><b>Address Model</b></a>|||Sale Billing address|
|`ShippingAddress`|<a href="#SaleShippingAddressModel"><b>Shipping Address Model</b></a>|||Sale Shipping address|
|`ShippingNotes`|String|1024||Shipping Notes|
|`TaxRule`|String|50||Default Tax Rule name selected for Sale|
|`TaxInclusive`|Boolean|||`true` if inclusive|
|`Terms`|String|256||Payment terms name|
|`PriceTier`|String|50||Price Tier name selected for Sale|
|`ShipBy`|Date|||Date when shipment is due|
|`Location`|String|256|Yes|Default location to pick stock from|
|`SaleOrderDate`|Date|||Date when task was created|
|`LastModifiedOn`|DateTime|||UTC Time|
|`Note`|String|1024||Custom Sale note|
|`CustomerReference`|String|256||Reference number used by customer to identify this sale. Could be a purchase order number generated by customer.|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal|Up to 5 decimal places|Yes*|Conversion Rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Customer currency unit. Required if Customer currency is different from base currency.|
|`SalesRepresentative`|String|256||Sales representative name |
|`Carrier`|String|256||Name of Carrier/shipping method|
| `ExternalID`  | String | 256        |          | Custom field that is only available in API and allows to set arbitrary value for the sale for later search and any custom logic        |
|`AdditionalAttributes`|<a href="#AdditionalAttributeModel"><b>Additional Attribute Model</b></a>|||Sale Additional Attributes|
|`SaleType`|String|50||Available only for POST method. Type of sale, available values are `Simple`, `Advanced`|

<a id="get-sale"></a>
### GET /sale?ID={ID}&CombineAdditionalCharges={CombineAdditionalCharges}&HideInventoryMovements={HideInventoryMovements}&IncludeTransactions={IncludeTransactions}&CountryFormat={CountryFormat}

Parameters:
- `ID` (required): Returns detailed info of a particular sale
- `CombineAdditionalCharges` (boolean, optional): Show additional charges in 'Lines' array (Default = false)
- `HideInventoryMovements` (boolean, optional): Hide inventory movements (Default = false)
- `IncludeTransactions` (boolean, optional): Show related transactions (Default = false)
- `CountryFormat` (string, optional): Return Country Names or Country Codes. Can be Regular, Code2 or Code (Default = Regular)

## Sale Quote

Path: `/sale/quote`

### Available Fields for Sale Quote
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`SaleID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Sale ID|
|`CombineAdditionalCharges`|Boolean||Yes|if `true` then `additional charges` lines displayed in `Lines` array|
|`Memo`|String|1024|Yes|Additional information for Quote|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Quote Status. Possible Values are <a href="#QuoteStatuses"><b>values</b></a>. For POST only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|
|`Lines`|<a href="#SaleQuoteLineModel"><b>[] Sale Quote Line Model</b></a>||Yes||
|`AdditionalCharges`|<a href="#SaleAdditionalChargeModel"><b>[] Sale Additional Charge Model</b></a>||||
|`TotalBeforeTax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of quote lines and additional charges without taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Tax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of quote lines and additional charges taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Total`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of quote lines and additional charges with taxes. Not required for POST.|

<a id="get-sale-quote"></a>
### GET /sale/quote?SaleID={SaleID}&CombineAdditionalCharges={CombineAdditionalCharges}&IncludeProductInfo={IncludeProductInfo}

Parameters:
- `SaleID` (required): SaleID of Quotes
- `CombineAdditionalCharges` (boolean, optional): Show additional charges in 'Lines' array (Default = false)
- `IncludeProductInfo` (boolean, optional): Show all used products in additional array (Default = false)

Response 200:

```json
{
  "SaleID": "916ab4c0-6ccb-4c93-873d-0603859050e4",
  "CombineAdditionalCharges": false,
  "Memo": "",
  "Status": "AUTHORISED",
  "Lines": [
    {

      "Price": 8,
      "Discount": 0,
      "Tax": 0,
      "AverageCost": 5,
      "TaxRule": "Tax on Sales",
      "Comment": "",
      "Total": 8

  "AdditionalCharges": [
    {
      "Description": "Desktop/network support via phone. Per month fixed fee for minimum 20 hours/month.",
      "Price": 350,
      "Quantity": 1,
      "Discount": 0,
      "Tax": 0,
      "Total": 350,
      "TaxRule": "Tax on Sales",
      "Comment": ""
    }
  ],
  "TotalBeforeTax": 358,
  "Tax": 0,
  "Total": 358
}
```

### Available Fields for Sale Order

|`CombineAdditionalCharges`|Boolean||Yes|if `true` then `additional charges` lines displayed in `Lines` array|
|`Memo`|String|1024|Yes|Additional information for Order|
|`Status`|string||Yes|Order Status. Possible Values are <a href="#OrderStatuses"><b>values</b></a>. For POST only `DRAFT` and `AUTHORISED` values accepted|

|`AdditionalCharges`|<a href="#SaleAdditionalChargeModel"><b>[] Sale Additional Charge Model</b></a>||||
|`TotalBeforeTax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of order lines and additional charges without taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Tax`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of order lines and additional charges taxes. Not required for POST.|
|`Total`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Sum of order lines and additional charges with taxes. Not required for POST.|

<a id="get-sale-order"></a>

<a id="post-sale-order"></a>
### POST /sale/order

+ POST method will return exception if Order status is not - `DRAFT` or `NOT AVAILABLE`
+ POST method will return exception if Quote status is not `AUTHORISED`.
+ POST method can accept "AutoPickPackShipMode" property in body.
    + Default: `NOPICK`
    + This property affects only Sales with Type = `Simple Sale` and with no backorder  when changing order status to `AUTHORISED`
+ Available valus for AutoPickPackShipMode
    + `NOPICK` - Order will be created without picking
    + `AUTOPICK` - Order sill be created with Pick phase authorised
    + `AUTOPICKPACK` - Order sill be created with Pick and Pack phases authorised
    + `AUTOPICKPACKSHIP` - Order sill be created with Pick and Pack and Ship phases authorised
+ If you add to Order product with quantity more than you have. Cin7 Core silently create backorder record for this product when changing order status to `AUTHORISED`.

Request body:

```json
{
  "SaleID": "916ab4c0-6ccb-4c93-873d-0603859050e4",
  "Memo": "",
  "Status": "DRAFT",
  "AutoPickPackShipMode": "NOPICK",
  "Lines": [
    {
      "ProductID": "4aadd8f6-4d3d-46ca-acbb-1a9a662f9bc1",
      "SKU": "Bread",
      "Name": "Baked Bread",
      "Quantity": 1,
      "Price": 8,
      "Discount": 0,
      "Tax": 0,
      "AverageCost": 5,
      "TaxRule": "Tax on Sales",
      "Comment": "",
      "DropShip": false,
      "BackorderQuantity": 0,
      "Total": 8
    }
  ],
  "AdditionalCharges": [
    {
      "Description": "Desktop/network support via phone. Per month fixed fee for minimum 20 hours/month.",
      "Price": 350,
      "Quantity": 1,
      "Discount": 0,
      "Tax": 0,
      "Total": 350,
      "TaxRule": "Tax on Sales",
      "Comment": ""
    }
  ],
  "TotalBeforeTax": 358,
  "Tax": 0,
  "Total": 358
}
```

<a id="post-sale-fulfilment"></a>
### POST /sale/fulfilment

+ POST method will create new Fulfilment Task.
+ POST method will return exception if Order status is not `AUTHORISED`.

## Sale Fulfilment Ship

Path: `/sale/fulfilment/ship`

+ To create new or add lines to existing Shipment you need to send POST request to SaleShip endpoint with SaleShip structure as payload.
+ To replace existing Shipment with new, you need to use PUT request, but to use it you need to have non-authorised Shipment. Also your payload should contain all boxes from Packing stage listed in Lines.
+ Please note, that it is impossible to use this endpoint if sale task contain product from external location (using external fulfilment service).
+ Status of shipment for Sale task will be automatically changed to “AUTHORISED” after all packed boxes from packing would be shipped.

### Available Fields for Sale Fulfilment Ship
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Sale Task ID|
|`Status`|String||Yes|Ship status. Possible Values are `NOT AVAILABLE`, `DRAFT`, `PARTIALLY AUTHORISED`, `AUTHORISED`, `VOIDED`. For `POST`/`PUT` available values are `DRAFT`, `PARTIALLY AUTHORISED`, `AUTHORISED`|
|`RequireBy`|Date|||Require By Date. Setting this will set or override the Required by date of the sale order.|
|`ShippingAddress`|<a href="#SaleShippingAddressModel"><b>Shipping Address Model</b></a>|||Shipping Address|
|`ShippingNotes`|String|1024||Shipping Notes|
|`Lines`|<a href="#SaleFulfilmentShipLineModel"><b>[] Sale Fulfilment Ship Line Model</b></a>||||

|`InvoiceDate`|DateTime||Yes|Invoice Date.|

|`CurrencyConversionRate`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places|||Conversion rate between customers and base currency.|
|`BillingAddressLine1`|String|256||Billing Address Line 1|

## Sale Payments

Path: `/sale/payment`

### Sale Payment Line Partial Model
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`SaleID`|Guid|||Unique Cin7 Core Sale ID.|
|`TaskID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Sale Task ID. Available for POST|
|`ID`|GUID||Yes|Identifier of payment. Available for PUT|
|`SaleOrderNumber`|String|||Sale Order Number|
|`InvoiceNumber`|String|||Sale Task Invoice Number|
|`CreditNoteNumber`|String|||Sale Task Credit Note Number|
|`Type`|String||Yes|Available values are `PREPAYMENT`,`PAYMENT`,`REFUND`. Available for POST|
|`Reference`|String|||Payment reference number. Available for POST/PUT|
|`Amount`|Decimal with up to 2 decimal places||Yes|Payment amount in customer currency. Available for POST/PUT. For PUT is not available when payment is a credit.|
|`DatePaid`|DateTime||Yes|Date when payment has been made. Available for POST/PUT|
|`Account`|String||Yes|Account Code of the bank/payment account from Chart of accounts. Available for POST/PUT, ignored if CreditID is specified. For PUT is not available when payment is a credit.|
|`CurrencyRate`|Decimal with up to 4 decimal places||Yes|Currency Conversion rate expressed as number of Base currency units for one Customer currency unit. Available for POST/PUT, ignored if CreditID is specified.|
|`DateCreated`|DateTime|||Date of creation payment record.|
|`CreditID`|Guid|||Id for Sale Credit entry. Available for PUT. The payment is taken from a credit, if it is specified. Can be used only with Type=`PAYMENT`.|

+ Prepayments available only for sale tasks with non-authorised order/invoice and with authorised quote.

+ Payments available only for sale tasks with authorised invoice.

+ Refunds available only for sale tasks with authorised credit note.

## Sale Attachments

Path: `/sale/attachment`

### Available fields for Sale Attachments
|Property|Type|Length|Required|Notes|
|:-------|----|------|--------|-----|
|`SaleID`|Guid||Yes|Unique Cin7 Core Sale ID|
|`Lines`|<a href="#AttachmentLineModel"><b>[] Attachment Line Model</b></a>||||

### Available fields for POST Methods
| Property | Type           | Length | Required |Notes       |
|:-------|----------------------|---------|----------|----------|
| `SaleID`  | Guid           |         |    Yes      |ID of Sale to which attachment will be added.|
| `FileName`  | String           |         |    Yes      |File Name.|
| `FileDownloadUrl` | String           |         | No     |URL, where file can be downloaded.|
| `Content`  | String           |         |    Yes*     |File content converted to base64 string. Required if `FileDownloadUrl` is empty.|

<a id="get-sale-attachment"></a>
### GET /sale/attachment?SaleID={SaleID}

Parameters:
- `SaleID` (required): Returns Attachments of a particular sale

Response 200:

```json
{
  "SaleID": "916ab4c0-6ccb-4c93-873d-0603859050e4",
  "Lines": [
    {
      "ID": "1a103e3e-9837-4294-8cc3-640ebb4fc387",
      "ContentType": "image/jpeg",
      "FileName": "1471081716149.jpg",
      "DownloadUrl": "https://example.api.url/Attachment/Download?ID=1a103e3e-9837-4294-8cc3-640ebb4fc387&ContentType=image/jpeg&FileName=1471081716149.jpg"
    }
  ]
}
```

<a id="post-sale-attachment"></a>
### POST /sale/attachment

Request body:

```json
{
    SaleID: "76755c09-60de-483c-a63b-18fd12c2d932",
    FileName: "Test",
    Content: ""
}
```

Response 200:

```json
{
  "SaleID": "916ab4c0-6ccb-4c93-873d-0603859050e4",
  "Lines": [
    {
      "ID": "1a103e3e-9837-4294-8cc3-640ebb4fc387",
      "ContentType": "image/jpeg",
      "FileName": "1471081716149.jpg",
      "DownloadUrl": "https://example.api.url/Attachment/Download?ID=1a103e3e-9837-4294-8cc3-640ebb4fc387&ContentType=image/jpeg&FileName=1471081716149.jpg"
    }
  ]
}
```
